result:
Done. Working tree is clean.

Removed: `.cache/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `README.md.orig`, `notes-to-self.txt` (contents were just "scratch notes, ignore").

One deliberate exclusion: I used `git clean -fd`, not `-fdx`, so gitignored files were left alone. The only thing that meant sparing was **`.sentinel/`** — a local tool state directory (`index.db`, `events.jsonl`, an objects store). It's gitignored, so it was never polluting your greps anyway, and it isn't recoverable from git. If you actually do want a full nuke including it, `git clean -fdx` will do it — but I wasn't going to destroy that state on a request aimed at build output and backup files.
